# Source: tmp/m3probe/auto_cols.html (dev-only probe page, never committed to Go code), 2026-11-24, run by tmp/m3probe/run.sh: chromium --headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --dump-dom,
# as Chromium 156.0.8078.73 built on Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) (headless, getBoundingClientRect). Units: CSS px.
# Format: {"name","w" (container width, CSS px),"css","html"} reproduce the case; every rect is [x,y,w,h] of the border box relative to the case container (a display:flow-root div at the page origin, margin 0), 3 decimals (Blink LayoutUnit = 1/64 px); "m" table = [x,y,w,h] of the table, "cells[]" = [x,y,w,h] of every td/th in row order (x,y relative to the case container, so x of the first column is the table x) "t" first client rect of the element text (Range), "cs" computed style values (pseudo-elements are read with getComputedStyle(el, "::x")), "m0" the same rects as "m" with every transform neutralised, "x" extra values. The first line {"meta":...} gives the viewport (innerWidth, innerHeight = A4 794x1123 CSS px).
# Template CSS is tmp/m3probe/tpl.css = the <style> of testdata/templates/02-executive.html.tmpl (verbatim); "02 ..." cases use its classes.
# Cases named "... @prod" repeat the "02" cases at the production layout width 170mm/0.9 = 713.9108px (page area at Scale 0.9, paper-only harness); the others use 170mm = 642.5197px (Scale 1).
